title: Pretty but also pretty cheap
text:
Pretty but also pretty cheap. I actually love Christmas socks, and used to collect them, decorating our whole house with them. So of course, I was drawn both to them being socks and them having sparkly gold stars on them.

First off, the red fabric is like a cheap, low-pile chenille. The gold stars are stamped on, and have a little bit of a holographic glitter on them. There is no inner liner. The back of the fabric feels like felt.

Then the cuff... it is white, and made of a slightly-longer-pile fabric. The cuff is lined with what feels like white felt. There is a generously-long red ribbon hanger sewn to the inside.

Now let's talk about construction. These have some decent fabrics - it is a shame they put them together so cheaply. The cuff is sewn on pretty badly. As in, you cannot fold the cuff over, and it is smaller than the sock, leaving a weird seam on the side.

So, these are cute enough, but the quality certainly is not there. If I was serious about using these at my house, I'd probably replace the cuff entirely with a faux fur.
